tasks.label: Configure Sanek Chord Finder
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $cmake = (Get-Command cmake.exe -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).Path; if (-not $cmake) { $cmake = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'CMake\bin\cmake.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cmake -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'CMake not found. Restart VS Code and check Get-Command cmake.exe in PowerShell.' }; Write-Host ('CMake: ' + $cmake); & $cmake --preset windows-msvc; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Build Sanek Chord Finder VST3
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $cmake = (Get-Command cmake.exe -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).Path; if (-not $cmake) { $cmake = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'CMake\bin\cmake.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cmake -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'CMake not found. Restart VS Code and check Get-Command cmake.exe in PowerShell.' }; Write-Host ('CMake: ' + $cmake); & $cmake --build --preset windows-release; exit $LASTEXITCODE
